name: 8-Chlorotheophylline
summary: 8-Chlorotheophylline is a stimulant substance belonging to the Xanthines chemical class.

pharmacology.text: 8-Chlorotheophylline, also known as 1,3-dimethyl-8-chloroxanthine, is a stimulant drug of the xanthine chemical class, with physiological effects similar to caffeine.

uses.text: The drug is also sold in combination with promethazine as a salt.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Like caffeine and other xanthines, it can cause restlessness, a faster heartbeat, trouble sleeping, nausea and headache, and too much can cause tremor and heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。和咖啡因及其他茶鹼類一樣，它可能引起躁動不安、心跳加快、睡眠困難、噁心與頭痛；過量則可能造成顫抖與心律不整。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。和咖啡因及其他茶碱类一样，它可能引起躁动不安、心跳加快、睡眠困难、恶心与头痛；过量则可能造成颤抖与心律不整。

fact.en: It is combined with the antihistamine promethazine to make dimenhydrinate-style travel sickness remedies, where the xanthine is added to offset the drowsiness.
fact.zh: 它會與抗組織胺異丙嗪（promethazine）結合，製成類似暈海寧的暈車藥；加入這種茶鹼類成分，是為了抵消藥物造成的嗜睡。
fact.zhHans: 它会与抗组织胺异丙嗪（promethazine）结合，制成类似晕海宁的晕车药；加入这种茶碱类成分，是为了抵消药物造成的嗜睡。
